act_title: The Pre-conception and Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994
title: Offence to be cognizable, non-bailable and non-compoundable
text:
27. Offence to be cognizable, non-bailable and non-compoundable.—Every offence under this Act

shall be cognizable, non-bailable and non-compoundable.
